knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The textbook states that a water level that is low draws air into the closed loop, which stops the system from circulating.
The textbook warning is that the pump must be turned off first, because the suction at the skimmer can injure fingers.
The gauge shows the operating pressure, and the reading taken when the unit is clean is the reference.

practicalCriteria: Each listed component is identified on site or on the layout, and any missing item is recorded
Water path is traced correctly from the pool towards the return
Pump is observed to be off before a vacuum line is attached to a skimmer
Water level is observed at the operating height before the pump is started
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Layout check record for one site
Photo of the skimmer and drain layout where the owner agrees
stopWorkCriteria: Vacuum hose connected to a running pump at a skimmer
Pump started with the water level low
Skimmer or drain used with a missing or damaged cover or basket
